rules: Bedrock Dedicated Server requer curl, wget, unzip e LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.
Servidores Java requerem openjdk-17 e criação do arquivo eula.txt=true.
Executar sempre em subpastas dedicadas fora da central.

recipes.command: pkg install -y openjdk-17 wget && mkdir -p servers/mc-java && cd servers/mc-java && wget -q https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/paper/versions/1.20.4/builds/496/downloads/paper-1.20.4-496.jar -O server.jar && echo 'eula=true' > eula.txt && java -Xmx1024M -Xms512M -jar server.jar nogui
pkg install -y curl php && mkdir -p servers/pmmp && cd servers/pmmp && curl -sSL https://get.pmmp.io | bash -s - && ./start.sh
